body: ## Summary - Settings → Your account → Delete account. The person re-enters the account number and types the handle, then confirms with a danger button. The page shows progress, signs out, wipes data on the device, and lands on “Your account was deleted”. The owner account does not see the button. - `POST /v1/account/delete` requires a session, a fresh account-number check (or a single-use re-auth token), an allowed Origin, `Content-Type: application/json`, and `X-Viktorych-Intent`. One D1 batch removes every row tied to that account, including backup owner keys (`owner_keys`, `owner_key_items`, `owner_key_pace`). R2 objects under the account prefixes are deleted. Every session is invalidated first. The handle stays reserved for 30 days (`HANDLE_HOLD_DAYS`; `0` frees it immediately). The owner account — including @former-account and former-account — is rejected before any write. - Publish jobs honor a deletions list that stores only an HMAC of the account id. The job row keeps its step state until the wipe is finished, and the minute cron resumes anything left behind. - Main is merged in. The backup-keys migration stays `0016_owner_keys_many.sql`; account deletion is `0017_account_deletion.sql`. On this device, deletion clears the new media and feed caches (service worker `wipeUserCaches`, the `viktorych-account-deleted` hook, and non-shell Cache Storage), along with the existing local stores. ## What is deleted - D1: profile, sessions, sync state (follows, likes, bookmarks, groups, feed tabs, notification tabs, drafts, watch history and resume), reposts, follows in both directions, drive vault/items/chunks, community posts/likes/members/notes, friend requests and friends in both directions, federation settings, ActivityPub followers for that handle, linked identities and challenges, vault configs/items/shares, owner keys and backup keys for that id, re-auth tokens, and rate-limit buckets for that id. - R2: `media/avatars`, `media/banners`, `uploads`, `exports`, `users`, and `accounts` objects under that account id. Public JSON (`people.json`, feeds, follows, suggestions) drops entries for that id on the next publish. - This device: `localStorage` keys for the app, the account IndexedDB databases (including the storage file index), and the service-worker data/media/live caches plus saved music. The app shell cache stays. - `telegram_files` is a shared media index with no account column, so it is left alone. There is no invites table. ## Tests - `worker/test/account-delete.test.mjs` seeds every account table, including backup-key rows, and R2, deletes one user, and asserts zero rows and objects remain for that user while another account and the owner are unchanged. It also covers owner protection, the emergency owner session, rate limits, re-auth, cron resume, and a zero-day handle hold. - `npm test` in `worker/` (87 tests), `node scripts/storage_test.js`, and `python3 scripts/check_i18n.py` pass. Strings are in en, ru, and es. Do not merge. `ACCOUNTS_WALL` in source is unchanged.

The Canadian Prepper video “Before Grocery Shelves Are Empty: A Survivalist Experts WARNING” (`7t8Llz1hszQ`, 56:50) was showing on Home as posted minutes ago. It is not in the channel RSS and not in `feeds.json`. It comes from the live Invidious channel feed (`/api/v1/channels/former-account`). That mirror has no upload time for this video, so it sets `published` to the fetch time and `publishedText` to “0 seconds ago” (the same stamp it puts on other undated uploads, including ones that do have a real RSS date). Home then treated that clock time as the publish time. A cached stamp a few minutes old slipped past the old 3-minute guard, and a missing date was filled from `seen-dates` or the sync clock. The real upload day on the YouTube watch page is **Oct 3, 2026** (`publishDate` “Oct 3, 2026”). A comment `dateCreated` on that page is not the upload. Home now keeps the channel RSS `` time, ignores relative and near-now mirror stamps, and does not invent a date from the fetch. A video with no real date is left undated, so it is not shown as new. The server lock does the same: a post with no trusted time stays undated, including one whose stored date was only the old first-seen stamp. Shipped on main as `b1a218e`. ## Story sources Checked live on 21 Oct 2026. Nothing is invented when a platform does not return a story file. | Platform | Result | | --- | --- | | Instagram | Needs a logged-in session. RSSHub `/instagram/stories/:user` requires `INSTAGRAM_COOKIE`. The official Graph API only returns the signed-in professional account’s own stories. This sync calls Instagram’s story query only when the optional `IG_SESSION` secret is set (`sessionid` and `ds_user_id`). It is separate from `INSTAGRAM_COOKIE`, masked, and never written into the repo. A session used from GitHub Actions can be checkpointed or disabled. A rejected session opens the existing sync-health issue immediately. Leave the secret unset and stories stay off. **Real Instagram stories are not flowing: `IG_SESSION` is not set, and this change does not create one.** | | Telegram | Does not work on a free public route. `t.me/telegram`, `t.me/durov`, `t.me/s/…`, and `t.me//s/1` return the channel preview or a profile card. The image is the avatar. `stories.getPeerStories` is limited to a logged-in user. No Telegram user session was added. | | VK | Off unless the optional `VK_USER_TOKEN` secret is set. The wall token cannot call `stories.get` (VK error 5, “User authorization failed”, checked for `vk` / `owner_id` `former-account`). With the secret, the sync calls only `stories.get` and `stories.getById`, paces them, and maps photo and video stories into `stories.json` with the same 24-hour expiry and the VK badge. Errors 5, 15, and 17 update the existing Sync problem issue and are not retried. The token is masked and never committed. Leave it unset and VK stories stay off. | | X | No stories. Fleets ended in 2021. | | YouTube | Stories ended on 26 June 2023. Shorts stay in the feed. | | Threads, Discord, RSS | No 24-hour story document on the free paths this sync uses. | Rebased onto latest `main` (`30da006`, the white SIntelApp tile). The service worker stays `superintel6-__SW_VERSION__`. An empty `stories.json` keeps the tray hidden. ## UI Followed accounts from every platform share one row under the Home tabs. Unseen accounts come first, then the newest. Each avatar is a rounded square with a platform badge. The viewer moves from one account to the next, including across platforms. Items older than 24 hours are dropped. Seen state stays on the device. `stories.json` is separate from `feeds.json`. The pictures below are a UI preview. The faces are the app icon and the VK clip is a local file, because none of the platforms returned live story media. [Phone story tray in Lights out](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-f7d131b4-91fe-58ba-9412-78784f809a91/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Ftray-phone-dark.png) [Desktop story tray in Lights out](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-f7d131b4-91fe-58ba-9412-78784f809a91/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Ftray-desktop-dark.png) [Desktop story tray in the light theme](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-f7d131b4-91fe-58ba-9412-78784f809a91/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Ftray-desktop-light.png) [Tablet story tray in Dim](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-f7d131b4-91fe-58ba-9412-78784f809a91/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Ftray-tablet-dim.png) [Phone story viewer](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-f7d131b4-91fe-58ba-9412-78784f809a91/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fviewer-phone.png) [Desktop story viewer](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-f7d131b4-91fe-58ba-9412-78784f809a91/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fviewer-desktop.png) [story-tray-and-viewer.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-f7d131b4-91fe-58ba-9412-78784f809a91/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fstory-tray-and-viewer.mp4) Chrome checked the empty tray, the shared order, taps, arrow keys, hold-to-pause, swipe to the next account, swipe down to close, unmute, and Escape at 390, 768, 1280, and 1920 in Lights out, Dim, and light. ## How to add VK_USER_TOKEN Same steps as `docs/vk-stories-token.md`. Checked against VK’s own pages on 21 Oct 2026. This sync reads `VK_USER_TOKEN` only inside the Refresh feeds step. It is masked, never printed, and never committed. Leave it unset and VK stories stay off. The sync calls `stories.get` and `stories.getById` only. It does not post, delete, or mark stories seen. 1. Sign in to the VK ID authorization service with your own VK account and create a business profile. Creating an app requires VK Business ID. Standalone app settings on dev.vk.com are no longer available; VK moved those apps to VK ID. Official page: https://id.vk.com/about/business/go/docs/ru/vkid/latest/vk-id/connection/create-application 2. In that cabinet open **Мои приложения**, click **Добавить приложение**, name it, choose platform **Web**, and set a base domain you control plus a trusted redirect URL. The redirect domain must exactly match the base domain, including case. Click **Создать приложение**. During creation, click **Подтвердить** on «Подтвердите профиль» so settings, keys, and support stay available. VK blocks the app when the business profile is not confirmed: accounts registered before 15 December 2025 had until 1 March 2026; accounts registered after that date are blocked 60 days after the first app. VK also blocks an app for an offer violation, a VK ID button that breaks their visual rules, or domains that do not match the app settings. 3. Do not use a third-party token site. The VK ID scope list is only `vkid.personal_info`, `email`, and `phone` (https://id.vk.com/about/business/go/docs/ru/vkid/latest/vk-id/connection/work-with-user-info/scopes). `stories` is not on it. `stories.get` says the stories right “is issued in exceptional cases by a request to support at devsupport@corp.vk.com” (https://dev.vk.com/en/stories.get). Write to that address from this app and ask for the stories right for your own account. VK’s user-info page says the same about other extended rights such as friends, video, and photos. 4. After VK grants that right and it is allowed on the app, authorize yourself with VK ID’s authorization-code flow and PKCE. Official page: https://id.vk.com/about/business/go/docs/ru/vkid/latest/vk-id/connection/start-integration/auth-without-sdk/auth-without-sdk-web - Generate a `code_verifier` of 43–128 characters from `a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`, `_`, `-`. `code_challenge` is `BASE64URL-ENCODE(SHA256(ASCII(code_verifier)))` and `code_challenge_method` is `S256`. - `state` is at least 32 characters from that same set. VK returns it unchanged; if it differs, discard the answer. - Open `https://id.vk.ru/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=YOUR_APP_ID&redirect_uri=YOUR_TRUSTED_REDIRECT&state=STATE&code_challenge=CHALLENGE&code_challenge_method=S256&scope=stories` - The redirect page must not contain scripts or embedded content (images, styles, counters). The code lives 10 minutes and arrives with `device_id`. Passing `scope=stories` before the app is allowed to request it returns `invalid_scope`. - Exchange it with `POST https://id.vk.ru/oauth2/auth`, `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, body `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code_verifier`, `redirect_uri`, `code`, `client_id`, `device_id`, and `state`. The `access_token` in that JSON is the secret value. A confidential app must also send `service_token`, and VK rejects the exchange unless it comes from an IP you listed. 5. What VK itself states about expiry and blocking: - A new VK ID access token lasts 1 hour. After that VK treats it as invalid (https://id.vk.com/about/business/go/docs/ru/vkid/latest/vk-id/connection/tokens/access-token). The refresh token lasts 180 days. `POST https://id.vk.ru/oauth2/auth` with `grant_type=refresh_token` returns a new pair and invalidates the previous pair. Reusing the old refresh token invalidates the whole session. This sync does not refresh tokens, so the next run after that hour gets error 5 and opens or updates the existing “Sync problem” issue. - The old `offline` right (bit +65536) sets `expires_in` to 0, so that key does not expire. VK’s access-rights page says it “is not used in the Open API” (https://dev.vk.com/en/reference/access-rights). It is not in the VK ID scope list, so a new VK ID token is not an offline token. - Implicit Flow and Authorization Code Flow for user keys were disabled on 25 June 2024 and cannot be used to obtain a new key. Keys issued before that and not revoked still work (https://dev.vk.com/en/api/access-token/getting-started). An old unrevoked stories key is the key that will not expire hourly. - `stories.get` still names a standalone Implicit Flow token and `VKWebAppGetAuthToken` in a mini app. That event’s scope list includes `stories` (“доступ к историям, созданным пользователем”) and the result includes an `expires` time. It runs inside the mini app, not in GitHub Actions (https://dev.vk.com/ru/bridge/VKWebAppGetAuthToken). - Error 5 is “Авторизация пользователя не удалась” (check the auth scheme). Error 15 is “Доступ запрещён” (check the ids, and that this user can open the content on the full site). Error 17 is “Требуется валидация пользователя”; VK says to redirect the user to its validation page (https://dev.vk.com/ru/reference/errors). This sync does not redirect and does not retry. - Until the business profile is verified, a new user gets 10,000 VK API calls a month, then 100,000,000. Those limits take effect on 7 September 2026. Authorization through VK ID is not counted. add it as the repo secret VK_USER_TOKEN in GitHub Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions. To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.

## Why On an installed Android Chrome PWA, the Russian VK post hid **Translate post**. The phone language was treated as the translation target, and a missing or UI-language detector was enough to mark the text as already translated. Desktop still had the old path that opened Google Translate. ## What changed - Script detection (Cyrillic → Russian, and the other non-Latin scripts) decides whether to show the control. A detector that reports English, or `lang === "no"`, cannot hide Cyrillic when the target is English. - The in-app action no longer calls `window.open` on translate.google.com. Translation stays in place (Chrome on tap, then Lingva, MyMemory, and the public Google endpoint), with **Show original**. - The service worker reloads an already-open window when it takes control, including a visible PWA, and treats `translate.js` / `translate.css` as shell files. `client.navigate` is not awaited inside `activate` (that deadlocks the reload). ## Live check Merged as `028483c`. The live service worker is `previews-028483c400a3b91288ef1ac0b986eee7e2471c35`. Android Chrome at 390, `navigator.language = ru-RU`, a detector that reports English, and no on-device Translator, on https://former-account.github.io/rss-feeds/#/vk/vk/status/former-account_1732596 : [Translate post visible at 390](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-d15f8740-41f1-5a1e-aac1-8c5e415113b5/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Flive-390-control.png) [Shimmer while translating](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-d15f8740-41f1-5a1e-aac1-8c5e415113b5/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Flive-390-shimmer.png) [Translated from Russian by MyMemory](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-d15f8740-41f1-5a1e-aac1-8c5e415113b5/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Flive-390-translated.png) [Show original restored the Russian text](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-d15f8740-41f1-5a1e-aac1-8c5e415113b5/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Flive-390-original.png) The control was blue and visible, the text shimmered, MyMemory replaced it in place (“Translated from Russian by MyMemory”, blue Show original), and Show original restored the Russian.
